# dist/

Build output. `Foton-Collect.ps1` is generated by `build/Build-Standalone.ps1`.

Copy **only that file** to an endpoint (RMM, USB). Do not deploy the module tree.

```powershell
.\build\Build-Standalone.ps1
# then on the target:
Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process Bypass -Force
.\Foton-Collect.ps1 -NoZip -OutputPath C:\FotonCases
```

Do not hand-edit the generated script. Change `src/` and rebuild.

`WinFoton.ps1` remains the frozen v1 reference until you are satisfied the flatten matches task names and finding titles.
